note: The bands the Freewing F-16 V3 70 mm EDF plant has to land in, from docs/F16-STAGE1.md, which derives each from Freewing's published figures (the V3 manual FJ211-V02 and the FJ21115P page), Model Aviation's review, the fan's maker's figures, NASA's ducted fan measurements (Weinstein et al., SciTech 2024) and NASA TP-1538's full size F-16 (scripts/f16-derive.js prints the derived figures). Each band is the Kadet's in proportion about its derived figure unless its source says otherwise. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead. Everything in the air is flown with the retracts up, as a jet pilot has them once clear of the field; the take off, the approach glide and the landing with them down, whose drag the table's cd0 carries (the P-51's retracts).

s1_level_50.source: level speed at half stick, the pattern speed the elevator is trimmed neutral at ('the model can also fly the pattern at surprisingly slow speeds', Model Aviation), derived 19.67, within 15 percent

s2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 11.98 at CLmax 1.1, the Kadet's -6 and +14 percent (the plant's stall blend rounds the curve off short of CLmax); alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.1 / 3.310, of the zero lift line

s3_glide.source: L/D at the approach speed, 1.3 Vs, 15.57 m/s, with the gear down as an approach is flown, derived 6.21 (7.09 clean), the Kadet's -11 and +12 percent

s4_top.source: level speed at full throttle: Freewing's 'maximum flying speed of 165kph', 45.83 m/s, which CD0 is fitted to, within 10 percent; Motion RC's 103 mph, 46.0 m/s, agrees

s5_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 14.94 at 25.5 m/s (a thrust to weight of 1.13, Freewing's 'strong vertical climbing performance'), the Kadet's -32 and +20 percent

s6_self_level.source: from a 30 deg bank at the pattern speed, every stick centred: the four state lateral model gives 22.9, 19.9 and 17.2 deg after 2, 4 and 6 s, a spiral that halves the bank in 9.4 s through the wing's sweep; the bank at 6 s, the same side, and never steeper than it started

s7_roll.source: full right roll stick from level flight at 30 m/s: strip theory's steady p b / 2V of 0.1317 at the F-16's 21.5 deg of aileron is 515 deg/s there, within 25 percent; the full size F-16's 324 deg/s at 250 m/s on its 9.45 m is 0.107, the same airframe's number to a fifth

s8_turn.source: a level 45 deg bank held on the ailerons: the radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown, within the Cub's 15 percent, level

s9_high_alpha.source: full up held from 20 m/s at 60 percent, the wings held level on the ailerons as the pilot of a high alpha pass does: the pitching moment through the stall's model trims at 31.5 deg of alpha (f16:derive, full up mush), Freewing's 'the aircraft can also maintain a high alpha of 30 degrees to demonstrate its superior low speed stability'; alpha over the last 2 s in the band, the ailerons still holding the wings within 15 deg (no wing drop they cannot catch), no yaw that is a spin. Hands off it is a slow spiral, which the gate prints and does not hold

s10_phugoid.source: the phugoid root of the four state longitudinal model trimmed at the 19.67 m/s pattern speed, derived 9.84, the Kadet's -18 and +17 percent

fromStop.source: full stick from a stopped fan: the ESC's 300 ms Normal startup ramp and the fan's critically damped speed at tau 0.08 s reach the speed of 90 percent of the static thrust at 0.562 s (f16:derive), within 10 percent; a prop reaches its in the step the stick moves

fromSpin.source: from a fan already turning at 30 percent to full: 0.343 s to 90 percent of the static thrust, within 10 percent

down.source: full to a closed stick: the thrust is under 10 percent 0.189 s later, within 10 percent

s12_thrust_vs_speed.source: full throttle at a held airspeed: the fan's thrust over its static 23.54 N against n^2 (1 - u / (76.87 n)), n the fan's speed over its full 41,703 rpm (the pack's sag slows it a little), NASA's C_T linear in the advance ratio to zero at J = 1.603 on the 69 mm rotor; at full speed 0.74 at 20 m/s and 0.48 at 40, within 3 percent of the static thrust

s13_energy.source: level at 75 percent, then the throttle closed and the height held: from the 33.86 m/s cruise to the 15.57 m/s approach speed takes 11.0 s and 261 m (f16:derive, energy), within 20 percent: a clean jet does not slow down, so an approach is planned from far out

s14_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, level, the CG 0.140 m up, 14.9 percent of the weight on the nose wheel (f16:derive, rest), within half a degree, 3 mm and 4 percent

s15_takeoff.source: full throttle on grass from a stopped fan, the elevator eased up to full past 1.2 Vs: the fan's thrust through the CG, 0.140 m over the mains' contact, holds the nose on its wheel until full up stabilator lifts it at 16.9 m/s after 17.3 m (f16:derive, rotation), so it lifts off between 1.3 and 1.6 Vs, from 0.9 of the roll to rotation to 1.1 of the roll to 1.6 Vs, 23.3 m: Freewing's 'short takeoff distance' at full power

s15b_scale_takeoff.source: the same at 55 percent, Model Aviation's 'takeoff throttle settings of 50% to 60% and gradual application of up-elevator will result in scalelike, shallow angle-of-attack departures': the fan's thrust with its speed squared and falling with the airspeed makes the roll to 1.2 Vs 72.2 m and to 1.6 Vs 308 m, the gear's drag in both (f16:derive), a long jet's roll; it lifts off between the two

s16_landing.source: an approach from 12 m at 1.3 Vs, 15.57 m/s, on the elevator and a 3.5 deg path on the throttle (at idle its glide is 8 deg steep), the throttle closed over the threshold at 1.2 m as Model Aviation's pilot does and the nose raised to 9 deg: a jet lands fast because its tail limits the flare, the nozzle's skid striking at 11.4 deg of pitch on the mains, so it touches no slower than 14.82 m/s, 1.24 Vs, and at 9 deg at 16.50 (f16:derive, touchdown), within 5 percent over that; it comes to rest on its three wheels at S14's attitude, no hull or skid, after a roll out of about 94 m with the gear's drag on the grass (f16:derive)

s17_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and every other aircraft's recorded flight hash in Node, from main's module at 4ea84e3, before the F-16 existed, and the P-51's two from main's at 1cce6bb, after #127 sharpened its stall on purpose (its own p51:gates S18 records the same two), before the F-16 joined it Re-pinned for the prop's slipstream and its gyroscope on every prop (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the recordings flown under power moved; the five inch's is as it was.

s18_cross_host.source: the F-16's recorded take off and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome

s20_stopped.source: the throttle closed on the strip: an electric ESC stops the fan (it has no idle), so nothing turns, nothing pushes, and the aircraft stands

s21_hands_off_glide.source: level at 75 percent, then the throttle closed and every stick let go, in Manual: the fan spools down to nothing and the neutral elevator's pitching moment trims the glide at 7.1 deg of alpha, 19.57 m/s sinking 2.68 m/s (f16:derive, hands off glide). The mean from 8 s, after the phugoid's first cycle; the sink within 15 percent, the speed S1's band, and it never reaches the stall's alpha

s22_chop.source: throttle closed from level flight at the pattern speed the elevator is trimmed neutral at, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble
